title: Caption Placement Check
user: A solo educator, creator, or small organization publishing captioned video who needs to know when captions cover a speaker, slide, sign-language interpreter, or essential on-screen text.
smallest_useful_product: A local drag-and-drop WebVTT/SRT plus video checker that samples frames, detects subtitle overlap with faces and dense text, and recommends safe zones or timed moves in a review list.
success_measure: For a labeled 30-video test set, flag at least 85% of known critical caption-overlap intervals with fewer than three false alerts per 10-minute video.
constraints: Run media locally; do not claim legal WCAG compliance; face/text detection must be advisory and be tested across non-Latin scripts.
